messages.text: How do changes in AI data centers technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

R&S CMX500 is a radio communication tester and a universal one-box network emulation and measurement solution for device testing across LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD [18].
CMX500 supports NR FR1 / FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, plus fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement and PER measurement [1].
AI data center infrastructure sources identify Connectivity, Power and Resilience as core data center aspects, and list Power Management, Rack & Accessories, Management System, Precision Cooling and Service as solution components [24].
AI server PCB trends are described as moving toward higher layer count, larger area and high-speed transmission [14].
The same PCB trend source says HVLP copper foil is moving to 4th / 5th generation, CCL is mainly M8, and low-dielectric, low-loss and high-thermal-dissipation designs are being introduced [14].
The same source says AI server motherboards reach 30–40 layers and require 12–14x aspect ratio processes, with challenges such as thick copper and laser drilling [14].
Data center connectivity is framed as full-spectrum, combining high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling and leak detection [6].
【推論】For signaling testers such as CMX500, AI-driven wireless or device-side requirements would mainly map to stronger coverage of NR FR1 / FR2 signaling, TX measurements, WLAN signaling, throughput, PER / BLER and fading/AWGN scenarios, because those are the supported CMX500 measurement areas rather than data-center power or PCB-fabrication measurements.[1][18]
【推論】For non-signaling / parametric test needs around AI data center hardware, the passages point more toward high-speed interconnect, PCB loss/impedance and power-integrity style measurement needs than toward cellular signaling, because AI server trends emphasize high-speed transmission, low-loss materials, high-layer PCBs, power distribution and cooling/connectivity infrastructure.[6][12][14][22]

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

XDP › 來源中的說法
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）展示基於 [[XDP]] 熱插拔控制器 `XDP70x` 與 [[CoolSiC]] [[JFET]] 技術的 [[eFuse]] 與 hot-swap 控制方案。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）稱，[[XDP]] 熱插拔控制器與 [[CoolSiC]] [[JFET]] 組合可在伺服器主板熱插入高壓直流匯流排時實現受控預充電。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）稱，該組合可即時監測電流，並在異常時快速斷開。
- [[infineon-powering-the-future-of-ai-whitepaper-cn 1]]（10/2025）稱，實驗條件為輸入電容 `300 µF`，可將伺服器主板從 `0 V` 預充電至 `800 V`。

[[AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping]] 是用來保存 [[AISeverEcosystem]] 中 AI server ecosystem 分類與 [[R&S Solution]] 欄位對應關係的概念頁；它只表示該 Excel 表中的銷售 / 測試方案線索，不代表正式產品配置、客戶關係或已驗證商機。

answer.text:
R&S CMX500 is a radio communication tester and a universal one-box network emulation and measurement solution for device testing across LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD [18].
CMX500 supports NR FR1 / FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements, plus fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement and PER measurement [1].
AI data center infrastructure sources identify Connectivity, Power and Resilience as core data center aspects, and list Power Management, Rack & Accessories, Management System, Precision Cooling and Service as solution components [24].
AI server PCB trends are described as moving toward higher layer count, larger area and high-speed transmission [14].
The same PCB trend source says HVLP copper foil is moving to 4th / 5th generation, CCL is mainly M8, and low-dielectric, low-loss and high-thermal-dissipation designs are being introduced [14].
The same source says AI server motherboards reach 30–40 layers and require 12–14x aspect ratio processes, with challenges such as thick copper and laser drilling [14].
Data center connectivity is framed as full-spectrum, combining high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling and leak detection [6].
【推論】For signaling testers such as CMX500, AI-driven wireless or device-side requirements would mainly map to stronger coverage of NR FR1 / FR2 signaling, TX measurements, WLAN signaling, throughput, PER / BLER and fading/AWGN scenarios, because those are the supported CMX500 measurement areas rather than data-center power or PCB-fabrication measurements.[1][18]
【推論】For non-signaling / parametric test needs around AI data center hardware, the passages point more toward high-speed interconnect, PCB loss/impedance and power-integrity style measurement needs than toward cellular signaling, because AI server trends emphasize high-speed transmission, low-loss materials, high-layer PCBs, power distribution and cooling/connectivity infrastructure.[6][12][14][22]

- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity
[[Data center full-spectrum connectivity]] 是 [[full-spectrum-data-center-connectivity-brochure]] 呈現的 portfolio 視角：把 AI / data center 的 high-speed electrical interconnect、optical interconnect、fiber deployment、rack power distribution、busbar、liquid cooling 與 leak detection 放在同一張 data center connectivity brochure 中。

AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping › 與既有知識的關係
- [[R&S PCB test solutions]] 提供 2026.3.4 R&S high-speed digital 簡報中的 PCB fabricator / system house 測試流程；本頁則來自市場 Excel，將 R&S 儀器與 AI server supply-chain 類別做銷售 mapping。
- [[高頻高速 PCB 測試解決方案]] 與 [[Dk-Df]]、[[Delta-L]]、[[TDR 阻抗測量]] 已有 Keysight / PCB test 圖像來源；本頁新增 R&S 方案對應，但未提供可替代正式規格的量測條件。
- [[AI 伺服器 PCB 供應鏈升級]] 記錄材料與板層升級；本頁只補充對應測試入口，例如 IL、TDR、high speed trace、PDN Target Z。
- [[資料中心電力電子生態系]]、[[NVIDIA 800V HVDC 架構]] 與 [[AI 資料中心高壓直流供電]] 記錄 data center power electronics；本頁補充 [[MXO]]、[[R&S FSWP]]、[[ZISO]] 與 BMS test 的 sales mapping 線索。

AI 伺服器 PCB 供應鏈升級 › 來源中的說法
- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）標題為「PCB供應鏈升級重點」。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱 AI伺服器趨勢推升 [[PCB]] 邁向高層數、大面積與高速傳輸，供應鏈全面翻新。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱 [[AWS Trainium 2 Max]]、[[Google TPU V6]]、[[Meta MTIA 2]] 量產，並稱 2026年新平台將陸續推出。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱 [[HVLP銅箔]] 進入第4、5代，[[CCL]] 以 [[M8]] 為主，導入低介電、低損耗與高散熱設計。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱主板層數達 30～40 層，縱深比需達 12～14 倍，並需應對厚銅、雷射鑽孔等高階製程。
- [[AI Server PCB test image 4]]（來源未標示日期；取得於 2026-09-04）稱 TPCA Show 焦點聚焦玻纖布、HVLP銅箔、CCL 發展與高縱深比設備，反映材料與製程全面升級。
- [[HSD PCB image 1]]（來源發布日期未標示；取得於 2026-09-04）以「GB200/GB300/VR200規格：南亞和臻鼎為亮點」為標題，比較 [[GB200]] NVL72(72GPU)、[[GB300]] NVL72(72GPU) 與 [[VR200]] NVL144(72GPU) 的時間、製程、功耗、載板、CCL 材料、上游材料、ComputeTray、NVSwitch Tray、CPX 與 Midplane。
- [[HSD PCB image 11]]（來源發布日期未標示；raw 轉換於 2026-09-04）與 [[HSD PCB image 1]] 高度重疊，同樣以「GB200/GB300/VR200規格：南亞和臻鼎為亮點」為標題，右上角標示「資料來源：產業調研、福邦投顧整理」。
- [[HSD PCB image 11]]（來源發布日期未標示；raw 轉換於 2026-09-04）列出 [[GB200]] / [[GB300]] ComputeTray 為 **5層22L**，[[VR200]] ComputeTray 為 **6層26L**；[[GB200]] / [[GB300]] NVSwitch Tray 為 **24L HLC**，[[VR200]] NVSwitch Tray 為 **32L (N+N HLC)**，[[VR200]] Midplane 為 **44L(N+N HLC)**。
- [[HSD PCB image 11]]（來源發布日期未標示；raw 轉換於 2026-09-04）列出 [[GB300]] 使用 **HVLP3銅箔**，[[VR200]] 使用 **HVLP4銅箔**，並將 [[VR200]] 交換板 CCL 材料列為 **M8(LDK2+HVLP4) 生益科技/台光電/南亞(交期最快)**。
- [[HSD PCB image 11]]（來源發布日期未標示；raw 轉換於 2026-09-04）列出 [[VR200]] ComputeTray PCB 供應商 / 占比為 **欣興35~40% > 臻鼎25~30% = 勝宏25~30%**。

⚠️ [[HSD PCB image 11]]（來源發布日期未標示；raw 轉換於 2026-09-04）說 [[VR200]] 交換板 CCL 材料供應為「生益科技/台光電/南亞(交期最快)」，但既有頁面 [[AI 伺服器 PCB 供應鏈升級]] 說 [[HSD PCB image 1]] 的對應欄位為「生益科技/台光電/南亞(交期最長)」。判斷：最快 / 最長方向相反，影響對 [[南亞]] 供應鏈定位的解讀；在回看原圖前不得擇一。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › Power 與 cooling connectivity
- [[Amphenol BarKlip I-O products]] / [[BarKlip Busbar Connectors]] — 來源稱其 distribute high-current power between busbars、cables and circuit boards，適用 power-dense data centers、OCP rack and power solutions。
- [[60 A Universal AC Input Connector and Cable Assemblies]] — 來源稱其 meet 2OU power distribution architecture standards，將 power 從 busway routing 到 power shelf。
- [[M-CRPS +54V Connectors and Cable Assemblies]] — 來源稱其 meet OCP M-CRPS power supply input specifications。
- [[PwrBlade ULTRA HD+ Cable Assembly]] — 來源稱其 Cable-to-Board serves as high-power I/O cable configuration in a low-profile design。
- [[OSFP-RHS 224G Cold Plate and Cage Assembly]] — 來源稱其 optimizes port thermal efficiency and reliability，meeting MSA requirements，並提供 one-step press assembly。
- [[Amphenol Liquid Cooling Leakage Detection Sensor Cable Assembly]] — 來源稱其 detects coolant leaks and ensures system reliability。
- [[Liquid Cooling Quick Disconnect Connectors]] — 來源稱其用於 high-efficiency thermal management。

AI Data Center image 2]] 與 [[0. AI Data Center image]] 則以未標示日期的 3D 機房示意圖列出 Power Management、Rack & Accessories、Management System、Precision Cooling 與 Service 等資料中心 solution components。[[4 AI Data Center Eco-Chain image 1]] 則在頁尾標示 12/10/2025（日期格式未標示）的 ecosystem map 中，補充 cloud service、datacenter、AI server、compute 與 peripheral 的市場參與者 / 品牌分類視角。
